Alias to D. lindheimeri, not D. lanuginosum simply from the historical species epithet.

decisions.rank: historical combination with misleading lindheimeri epithet
decisions.action: This historical lindheimeri variety maps to D. lanuginosum in POWO, NOT to D. lindheimeri; never bulk-map all historical Panicum lindheimeri infraspecifics to one species.

decisions.rank: historical combination with misleading lindheimeri epithet
decisions.action: This historical lindheimeri subvariety belongs to separately accepted D. meridionale under POWO; not a synonym of D. lindheimeri.

decisions.source_name: Historical broad Panicum acuminatum / Dichanthelium acuminatum complex
decisions.action: POWO retains alternative broad acuminatum treatments in authority history. Thomas (2015) separated multiple species using morphology and type material; historical observations without original vouchers cannot automatically be assigned to the modern narrow D. lindheimeri.

decisions.source_name: Dichanthelium lindheimeri versus Dichanthelium lanuginosum / longiligulatum
decisions.rank: primary diagnostic concept, not a specimen determination
decisions.action: Thomas (2015), pp. 21, 37–39: D. lindheimeri spikelets typically 1.3–1.7 mm, sheaths mostly glabrous, basal leaf-margin cilia long and crooked, ligule 2.0–3.2 mm; traits overlap other species. These are literature criteria only, not verified on the learner's unmeasured photo.

Canonical card currently flags unmeasured scene imagery and absent tied ligule/spikelet voucher; name-level PASS must not clear photographic identity. No photographs examined or modified in taxonomy lane.

source_notes.POWO_WCVP: 2026-10-23 live accepted-name, six listed homotypic synonyms, separately accepted D. acuminatum/D. lanuginosum/D. meridionale; exact source pages cited.
